"Artificial intelligence must be shaped by humanity, with humanity, and for all humanity.

author: tobyn.bsky.social
text: UN Sec-Gen António Guterres' speech to the General Assembly doesn't mince his words on Big Oil www.un.org/sg/en/conten...

images.alt:
António Guterres, UN Secretary-General, 22nd Sept 2026 speech:

"For decades, Big Oil has treated the atmosphere as an open sewer – and cashed in on the consequences. 


Since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, five major Western oil companies have pocketed nearly half a trillion dollars in profits.


Compare that with just 34 billion dollars in international public adaptation finance for developing countries in the latest year reported.


Meanwhile, everyday people are paying more for energy, food and insurance.


We have seen this kind of abuse of power before.


When the harms of Big Tobacco became undeniable – governments acted.


The climate crisis demands the same determination. 


Those who polluted the most – and profited the most – must do far more to repair the damage they caused.


Polluters must pay. "
